objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All three pull_request/push workflows (deploy, docs-site, tests) received deliberate trigger decisions, and the required `unit-tests` check was given exactly the correct shape — a single always-run workflow with no workflow-level path filter, gating real work via a computed `if:` output rather than a companion skip workflow or a trigger-level filter — so no cap applies.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths map to what it actually consumes (deploy: src/deps/deploy.sh/self; docs-site: docs/mkdocs.yml/self; tests' internal detection: src/test/package*/self) with no catch-all or sibling copying, though a few (e.g. test/ dir name, deploy.sh) rest on reasonable but unverified assumptions.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: Left the schedule-only nightly-sweep, issue-driven triage, and the branch-protection ruleset untouched and created no unneeded docs, with only the minor, explicitly-flagged addition of workflow_dispatch (plus necessary fetch-depth) to tests.yml going slightly beyond pure filtering.
